$comment: The price book. DATA, not code.
The Worker emits no usage events and knows nothing about money. This file is
the only place a number lives, so a price change is a one-file edit and never a
deploy of the thing a patient reaches an emergency screen through.
NOTHING HERE IS PUBLISHED. Every plan is status 'proposed' and every entry in
billingGates is met:false. docs/business-model.md explains each gate. Numbers
exist so they can be argued with, not because anyone may be billed from them.
meteredDimensions is EMPTY ON PURPOSE. At R0 the Worker returns 503 for every
route (src/app.ts), so it counts nothing. A dimension listed here that the
Worker does not actually count would be a promise to invoice from a meter that
does not exist. tests/pricing-invariants.test.ts refuses that file rather than
letting an invoice quote a number nobody measured.
forbiddenDimensions is not decoration. G11 limits notification to three
urgency-only channels so the app cannot find reasons to contact people. A price
per notification would pay the operator to send them, which is the incentive
G11 exists to remove. The billing unit must not re-create what a constitutional

candidateDimensions.describes: one completed disclaimer -> intake -> emergency-screen -> verdict cycle

forbiddenDimensions.why: G11 — a price per notification pays the operator to notify
R1 derives a 30-day rotating pseudonym DID in the browser; there is no stable person to count, and a seat wall would sit in front of the G5 emergency screen
accuracy is a device claim; selling it crosses the 薬機法 medical-device threshold this tier stays below

billingGates.description: 医療機器該当性 settled for the advisory tier (PMDA SaMD consultation or documented self-assessment on file)
terms of service and 特定商取引法 disclosure for the operating entity
if the operator is a 医療機関, surface reviewed against the 医療広告 事例解説書
a payment rail exists at all

plans.name: Adherent
plans.why: a price a person must get past before the G5 emergency screen runs is a price standing between someone and an ER routing instruction

plans.name: Operator — self-host
plans.audience: 宗教法人 / clinic / 産業医 running the Worker themselves
plans.why: Apache-2.0 + Charter Compliance Rider; the real cost of entry is the R1 baseline attestations, which are not payable in money

plans.name: Operator — managed tenancy
plans.audience: operators who want the attestations honoured and the Worker run for them
plans.why: flat, with no usage component, because nothing is metered; the number is a starting point for argument and is not chargeable until every billingGate is met
